continuity: The Myriad-Poison Ring is the only currently known potential treatment for Jeok Cheongang's Formless Ultimate Poison, and obtaining it is a mandatory Quest.
Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang remain at Dong Feng's clinic to guard Venerable Myoryeong while Taekyung, Cheongpung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong approach the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Tang Sadok suspects that the one-armed killer who murdered the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and three Emei Elders also murdered Tang Taesang.
plot: The System generates the mandatory Peak-grade Chain Quest Myriad-Poison Ring, requiring Jin Taekyung to obtain the legendary Sichuan Tang Clan treasure or Jeok Cheongang will die. Taekyung concludes that the ring must exist because the System created the Quest.
Taekyung leaves Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang at Dong Feng's hidden clinic to guard Venerable Myoryeong, while he, Cheongpung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong travel to the Sichuan Tang Clan to seek the ring.

Tang Sadok returns to the Sichuan Tang Clan after receiving Qingcheng's report that a single attacker killed the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and three Emei Elders. He orders the Green Shadow Squad to investigate and tightens security around the Gate Guard Pavilion.
Tang Sadok allows Taekyung's group to enter after learning that Dong Feng may be the Divine Physician. Taekyung immediately asks Tang Sadok to lend him the Myriad-Poison Ring.
translation_decisions: Render 녹영대 as Green Shadow Squad.
Render 익산 as Yishan and 삼합 as Sanhe.
Render 노빠꾸 상남자식 화법 as no-brakes macho-man talk or approach, preserving Taekyung's modern comedic phrasing.

active_continuity: The mandatory Myriad-Poison Ring Quest requires Jin Taekyung to obtain the legendary Tang Clan treasure or Jeok Cheongang will die.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison while Dong Feng's treatment is being prepared.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong are entering the Sichuan Tang Clan to seek the Myriad-Poison Ring.
Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang remain at Dong Feng's hidden clinic to guard Venerable Myoryeong.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal and is expected to have no immediate problems if she rests.
Tang Sadok has returned to the Sichuan Tang Clan after receiving Qingcheng's report about the murders on Mount Emei.
The one-armed middle-aged killer murdered the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and three Emei Elders in a direct confrontation.
Tang Sadok has deployed the Green Shadow Squad to investigate the killer and strengthened security around the Gate Guard Pavilion.
open_questions: Does the Sichuan Tang Clan possess the Myriad-Poison Ring, and will Tang Sadok lend it to Taekyung?
Can Taekyung obtain a viable antidote and save Jeok Cheongang before his treatment deadline?
Who is the one-armed middle-aged killer, and is he responsible for both the Mount Emei massacre and Tang Taesang's murder?
Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?
temporary_decisions: Render 활신대법 as Life-Restoring Great Technique.
Render 무형지독 as Formless Ultimate Poison.
Render 녹영대 as Green Shadow Squad.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Legendary physician also known as Dong Feng and Mungyeong's Master, who runs a hidden clinic in Sichuan, treats Venerable Myoryeong, and is preparing treatment for Jeok Cheongang after identifying Formless Ultimate Poison in his body.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Legendary physician also known as Dong Feng and Mungyeong's Master, who runs a hidden clinic in Sichuan, treats Venerable Myoryeong, and accompanies Taekyung's party to the Sichuan Tang Clan in search of the Myriad-Poison Ring for Jeok Cheongang's treatment.

profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Beggars' Sect Successor Beggar and unique eight-knot disciple who remains at Dong Feng's hidden clinic with Hyuk Mujin to guard Venerable Myoryeong.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** A Level 50 First Rate martial artist who serves as Captain of the Jin Family's Gatekeepers and Vice Squad Leader of the Jin Dragon Squad, and is traveling with Jin Taekyung in Sichuan.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** A Level 50 First Rate martial artist who serves as Captain of the Jin Family's Gatekeepers and Vice Squad Leader of the Jin Dragon Squad, and remains at Dong Feng's hidden clinic with Gung Gibang to guard Venerable Myoryeong.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple and the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, who has brought Jeok Cheongang to Dong Feng for treatment in Sichuan.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple and the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, who is leading a party to the Sichuan Tang Clan to obtain the Myriad-Poison Ring for Jeok's treatment.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Jin Mukyung is his older brother and fellow martial artist; his mother, sister Hayeon, and the Jin Family are the people he protects. Jeok Cheongang is his Master and the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox heir-maker; Taekyung calls him Master publicly and Old Master privately. Cheongpung is his trusted younger-brother-like companion. Song Song rejected his romantic confession but remains his same-age friend and guildmate. Lee Seowol is a strained political and personal connection whose proposal he intends to reject. Won Myunghoon is dead after their alliance collapsed. Hwangbo Eom, Ju Hwaran, Baek Museong, Hyuk Sopyung, and Song Il are involved in the current Tengwang Pavilion crisis; Ju Hwaran suspects Zhongnan of betraying the escort mission.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Jin Mukyung is his older brother and fellow martial artist, his mother and sister Hayeon are among the people he protects, Jeok Cheongang is his Master and the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox heir-maker, Cheongpung is his trusted younger-brother-like companion, Song Song remains his same-age friend and guildmate after rejecting his confession, Lee Seowol is a strained political and personal connection, and Won Myunghoon is dead after their alliance collapsed.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Young medical apprentice and Disciple of Dong Feng who guided Jin Taekyung's party to his Master's hidden clinic in Sichuan.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Young medical apprentice and Disciple of Dong Feng who accompanies his Master and Jin Taekyung's party to the Sichuan Tang Clan in search of the Myriad-Poison Ring.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and son of Poison King Tang Taesang, responsible for directing the clan’s response to his father’s murder.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and son of Poison King Tang Taesang, who has returned to the clan to investigate his father's murder and the Mount Emei massacre.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Tang Taesang was his father and predecessor as Family Head; he knows Jeok Cheongang as Senior Jeok and refuses Jin Taekyung’s request for direct aid while the Tang Clan pursues his father’s killers.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Tang Taesang was his father and predecessor as Family Head, his unnamed nephew serves as Master of the Gatekeeper Pavilion, and the Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake was his father's final gift and is his cherished companion.
